<domain>
## Phase Boundary

The system produces job mismatch scores comparing AI claim intensity to actual AI hiring activity and role quality. Ingests AI-related job postings using JobSpy or similar free scraping sources with deduplication via deterministic hash matching. A role classifier distinguishes AI/ML engineering roles from marketing/strategy roles that mention AI. The job mismatch score (0-100) computes the gap between AI claim intensity and genuine AI hiring activity, with ghost job detection lifecycle tracking.

</domain>
